十一个人，最终没有一个合格，除了王林外，还有一个少女也同样踏入到两丈处，但结果依然。
当天测试完，众少年就被遣散到山下，被恒岳派弟子一一送走，送王林回家族的，还是带他们来此地的那个张姓青年，在他的身边，跟着王卓与王浩。
“王卓师弟，恭喜你成为道虚师叔的弟子，以后前途不可限量。”青年含笑，抱拳道。
王卓脸上露出不可一世的表情，傲然道：“那是自然，师父已经说了，只待我这次回家处理完俗事，便传我修仙法术。”
王浩在一旁撇嘴，说道：“我从小就看不上你那副小人得志的表情，不就是有师父么，算什么大不了的，小爷还会炼丹呢。”
王卓轻蔑的看了眼王浩，没理会他，而是目光转动，望着一旁沉默不语的王林，轻笑道：“铁柱，怎么样，之前我就和你说了，你没那块料，你和你爹都不信，现在知道结果了吧。”
王林抬头，淡淡的看了眼王卓，对恒岳派青年说道：“上仙，我父母都在等我，还请您快些把我送回去吧。”
王卓看见王林居然不理会自己，再次冷笑道：“土包子，这辈子就待在村子里像你爹一样当木匠吧。”
青年脸中露出似笑非笑的表情，看了看眼前的三个少年，也没说话，袖子一卷，带着三人消失在恒岳派山门。
回去的路上，罡风依旧，可王林的心绪，却是天地之别，来时期望，回时绝望。
时间不长，王氏家族大宅子目光可及，王林睁开双眼，远远望去只见大宅子内人头怂恿，热闹似锦，一桌桌档次远远超过他爹前几日招待亲戚的宴席，把整个大院子都铺满。
王氏家族所有人，甚至连那些在外地采购木料的族人也都回来，齐聚一堂相互庆祝，觥筹交错，熙来攘往。
这次宴席的主角是三个人，王天水的大哥，王天水，以及他的三弟，在这三个人身边，所有的亲戚都相互上前庆祝，场面热闹非凡。
他们眼中毫无例外都是露出羡慕之色，口中更是阿谀奉承，尽挑好词，尤其是对王林的父亲，更是磋叹不已，唏嘘往事。
“二哥，这次你家小子一定会被选中，以后你就不用干木匠活了，家里谁看见你不得叫一声二爷啊。”王林父亲的六弟，一个大腹便便的中年人，大声赞道。
“老二，当年我就看出你这辈子绝对不一般，怎么样，让我看对了吧，你这辈子应在铁柱身上了，铁柱成为仙人，你这当爹的，那可就了不得了。”王天水的五叔，眯个小眼睛，坐在王林父亲身边，举杯阿谀说道。
“二哥，你家铁柱和我家小子，这次都能被选中，咱哥俩有十几年没见了，这次说什么也要不醉不归。”王浩的父亲，王天水的三弟，端着酒杯来到面前，一脸的笑意，大声说道。
铁柱父亲望着四周这些之前瞧不起他的亲戚们，颇感扬眉吐气，风光无限，多年的阴郁一扫而空，不过却始终有一块大石压在心头。

“铁柱啊，一定要被选中！”
“二嫂，你跟着我二哥这辈子算是享福了，有了铁柱这孩子，以后咱们十里八村的，谁不认识你啊。”
“就是，二嫂，你家娃娃可比我家小子有本事，铁柱这孩子从小就明聪，真是个好孩子啊。”
“铁柱娘，咱们虽说是同族，但现今同族通婚的多了去，我家闺女也到了年纪，铁柱这孩子仪表堂堂，我从小就喜欢，不如咱们两家结个亲家？”与铁柱父亲一样，铁柱母亲身边也围绕着一群女眷，相互热情的唠着乡间家常。
铁柱的大哥，冷眼望着这一切，内心暗道等着吧，等仙人把孩子送回来，就知道结果了，到时候若是铁柱没被选中，看老二你如何收场。
想到这里，他面上哈哈一笑，端起酒杯与身边夸奖他家孩子的亲戚，应承了几句。
场面沸沸扬扬，繁闹不已。就在这时，忽然一道长虹从天际划过，落在大院子中，露出四人。
四周瞬间安静下来，所有的王氏族人都兢兢战战，不敢说话。
恒岳派青年目光一扫，暗自感叹，他当日被恒岳派收为弟子时，家乡人也是这样庆祝，一时之间颇为感慨，回头深深的看了眼王林，他知道这少年接下来要面对的事情，是成年人都无法承受的。

Of the eleven people, no one qualified in the end. Apart from Wang Lin, there was also a girl who also stepped into the two-foot mark, but the result was still the same.
After the test that day, the young men were sent down the mountain and sent away one by one by the disciples of the Hengyue Sect. The one who sent Wang Lin back to his family was the young man named Zhang who had brought them here, with Wang Zhuo and Wang Hao by his side.
"Junior brother Wang Zhuo, congratulations on becoming the disciple of Uncle Daoxu. Your future is limitless." The young man said with a smile and clasped his fists.
Wang Zhuo showed an arrogant expression on his face and said proudly: "That's natural. Master has already said that he will teach me the magic of cultivating immortals when I go home this time and finish handling my mundane matters."
Wang Hao pouted at the side and said: "I have always looked down upon your triumphant expression since I was a child. Isn't it just that you have a master? It's not a big deal. I can also make elixirs."
Wang Zhuo glanced at Wang Hao contemptuously and ignored him. Instead, he turned his eyes and looked at Wang Lin who was silent on the side. He chuckled and said, "Tie Zhu, how are you? I told you before that you didn't have that piece of material. Neither you nor your father believed it. Now you know the result."
Wang Lin raised his head, glanced at Wang Zhuo indifferently, and said to the young man from the Hengyue Sect: "Shangxian, my parents are waiting for me. Please send me back as soon as possible."
Wang Zhuo saw that Wang Lin was ignoring him and sneered again: "You bumpkin, just stay in the village and be a carpenter like your father."
There was a half-smile on the young man's face. He looked at the three teenagers in front of him without saying a word. He rolled up his sleeves and disappeared from the gate of Hengyue Sect with the three of them.
On the way back, the strong wind was still there, but Wang Lin's mood was completely different. He was expecting when he came, but was disappointed when he returned.
Not long after, the Wang family's mansion was within sight. Wang Lin opened his eyes and saw from a distance that the mansion was crowded and lively. The tables were of a higher quality than the banquet his father entertained relatives a few days ago, covering the entire courtyard.
Everyone in the Wang family, even those who purchased wood from other places, came back and gathered together to celebrate each other, drink and drink, and bustle with each other.
The protagonists of this banquet were three people, Wang Tianshui's eldest brother, Wang Tianshui, and his third brother. Around these three people, all the relatives came forward to celebrate with each other, and the scene was very lively.
Without exception, their eyes were full of envy, and their mouths were flattering and full of good words. Especially for Wang Lin's father, they were sighing and lamenting the past.
"Second brother, your boy will definitely be chosen this time. You won't have to do carpentry work anymore. No one in the family will call you Second Brother when they see you." Wang Lin's father's sixth brother, a middle-aged man with a big belly, praised loudly.
"Second brother, I knew back then that your life was definitely extraordinary. How about, let me see it right. You should be with Tie Zhu in this life. Tie Zhu became an immortal. As a father, that would be amazing." Wang Tianshui's fifth uncle narrowed his eyes, sat next to Wang Lin's father, and raised his glass to flatter him.
"Second brother, your Tiezhu and my boy are both selected this time. We haven't seen each other for more than ten years. This time, we can't do anything without getting drunk." Wang Hao's father, Wang Tianshui's third brother, came to the front with a wine glass and said loudly with a smile on his face.
Tie Zhu's father looked around at the relatives who had looked down on him before, and felt proud and proud. Years of gloom had been swept away, but there was always a big stone weighing on his heart.
"Tie Zhu, you must be chosen!"
"Second sister-in-law, you have been blessed by following my second brother in your life. With this child, Tiezhu, no one in our villages will know you."
"That's right, second sister-in-law, your baby is better than my boy.He has the ability. Tie Zhu has been smart since he was a child. He is really a good kid. "
"Mother Tiezhu, although we are from the same race, there are too many intermarriages among the same race nowadays, and my daughter is also old. I have liked Tiezhu's handsome child since I was a child. Why don't we get married? "Like Tiezhu's father, Tiezhu's mother is also surrounded by a group of female relatives, chatting enthusiastically with each other about country affairs.
Tiezhu's eldest brother looked at all this with cold eyes and secretly thought to himself, wait and see. When the immortal sends the child back, he will know the result. If Tiezhu is not selected by then, let's see how you end up.
Thinking of this, he smiled, picked up his glass of wine, and said a few words of agreement to the relatives beside him who were praising his children.
The scene was lively and noisy. At this moment, a long rainbow suddenly flashed across the sky and landed in the large courtyard, revealing four people.
The surrounding area suddenly became quiet, and all the Wang clan members were trembling and did not dare to speak.
The young man from the Hengyue Sect swept his eyes and sighed secretly. When he was accepted as a disciple by the Hengyue Sect, the people in his hometown celebrated in the same way. He was quite emotional for a moment and looked back at Wang Lin deeply. He knew that what this young man would face next was something that even an adult would not be able to bear.
